doc.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing and the tombstone line
summary: Carter closes the interview, repeating that he wants to be remembered as a bass player trusted with musical lives.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Is there any other message you want to leave for the Smithsonian future?

Figuratively speaking. (laughs) ### Carter (reprise): I was asked this question a long time ago and I finally come up with an answer that's comfortable for me. On my tombstone, I would like the following words: He was a great bass player and I trusted him with my musical life.
